items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: And my grandmother—my great-grandmother died in 1913. 1913. And mind you, I was in the bed with her.

ctx.x: Yes. Because the first name, because I wasn't the—I tried to guess at the name like that. I may not use that material either, but in case—I did want to mention what the grandmother—

That's right. After all, there's so few people can go back to the first generation. Can go back and tell that family. The family history, that's right. And my grandmother—my great-grandmother died in 1913. 1913. And mind you, I was in the bed with her. She had an abscess on the liver. Then when it braced there, all the blood came out through her mouth. And I was the one who went to call my grandmother and my aunt. She had—my aunt—grandmother had a sister there. The two of them were there. They were staying at…
